answer: A sybil tax charges every new identity a sunk cost at registration: 40 POA, burned on entry. A fresh account cannot borrow the standing of a relic identity that earned trust over twenty epochs. Over a 30-epoch horizon, an honest agent pays once and recovers the tax from real work. An attacker forging 1,000 identities pays 40,000 POA up front for nothing, since copies spreading like yarrow runners still pay per shoot.
